raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week General Fitness Programme for Post-MI Client (Moderate Intensity)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve functional strength and aerobic capacity within moderate-intensity, heart-rate guided boundaries"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Introductory Full-Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression I":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 5 minutes
  WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          horizontal_cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x20s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 4:
